blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu is set to make history as the first school outside the National Capital Region (NCR) to compete in the University Athletic Association of the Philippines (UAAP) high school football tournament, marking a major milestone for Cebuano football. UP Cebu will field a high school boys’ team as a guest participant in UAAP Season 89, giving its young footballers an opportunity to compete against some of the country’s top high school programs. Despite the pressure and expectations that come with representing their school, city, and region, the team is approaching the […]...
